_note: Approved/limited_use snapshot only. Not the full research dataset. A phrase here is a candidate to consider when it fits the exact meaning, platform, audience and register of the copy you're writing — never insert it just because it's listed.

phrases.english_concept: fancy/aesthetic decorative text
phrases.usage_guidance: Primary head-term for the whole ID product; use as the umbrella label for the generator itself, not for a single font family.
phrases.good_example: "Tulisan aesthetic itu huruf-huruf yang kelihatannya kayak font khusus... tapi sebenernya tetap teks biasa yang bisa kamu copy paste" (id/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a - this is the site's own primary term

phrases.english_concept: the English word 'aesthetic' kept as-is inside Indonesian phrases
phrases.usage_guidance: Keep 'aesthetic' untranslated when used as a suffix (bio-ig-aesthetic, nama-kontak-pacar-aesthetic) - this is how the community actually writes it, not 'estetik' in that slot.
phrases.good_example: usecase slugs: bio-ig-aesthetic, bio-tiktok-aesthetic, bio-wa-aesthetic, nama-kontak-pacar-aesthetic, nama-couple-ff-aesthetic, nama-ig-aesthetic
phrases.avoid_when: In prose sentences where a fully Indonesian phrase (tulisan aesthetic, huruf estetik) reads more natural than a bare English adjective mid-sentence.

phrases.english_concept: cool/stylish text (generic)
phrases.content_surface: meta title, category hub, generator page
phrases.usage_guidance: Broader/more mainstream synonym of 'tulisan aesthetic' - reaches an older or less TikTok-native audience.
phrases.good_example: "Font Discord — tulisan keren buat nick & bio" (id/category/index.html); site meta title "Tulisan Aesthetic & Tulisan Keren"
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: cool font
phrases.usage_guidance: Use interchangeably with 'tulisan keren' in cross-links/CTAs ("Buat tulisan & font keren").
phrases.good_example: "Buat tulisan & font keren" (id/symbol/index.html, id/symbol/simbol-kutip/index.html, id/symbol/simbol-derajat/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: aesthetic letters
phrases.content_surface: homepage FAQ, meta description, cross-sell module
phrases.usage_guidance: Use as a rotating synonym alongside tulisan aesthetic/tulisan keren/font aesthetic in FAQ copy to cover query variants - do not make it the sole primary term (lower standalone volume signal than 'tulisan aesthetic').
phrases.good_example: "orang nyebutnya macem-macem: ada yang bilang tulisan bagus, tulisan keren, font aesthetic, atau huruf estetik" (id/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: copy-paste (the action)
phrases.register: everyday informal, not slang - used in headlines/meta by mainstream Indonesian sites
phrases.usage_guidance: Safe as a primary CTA/instruction verb site-wide; 'salin tempel' is the more formal/neutral synonym (used interchangeably, e.g. in title casing 'Salin & Tempel'). Do not treat 'copas' as slang requiring a disclaimer - it is standard informal register, comparable to writing 'copy-paste' in English marketing copy.
phrases.good_example: "Copas Font Online (Copy Paste)" (locales/id.json meta title); "Bikin & copas font lucu" (id/font-lucu); "Simbol Nickname: Salin & Tempel" (id/library/simbol-nickname)
phrases.avoid_when: In very formal/legal copy (privacy policy, ToS) where 'menyalin dan menempel' is more appropriate.

phrases.english_concept: the ꧁꧂ Javanese-script ornamental brackets used to frame gaming nicknames
phrases.content_surface: usecase pages, library symbol pages, FAQ
phrases.usage_guidance: Use 'payung' as the community-facing label for ꧁꧂ instead of a technical Unicode-block description - this is genuinely how ID gamers refer to it, confirmed independently outside the repo (VexaGame: "Nama FF Keren Payung").
phrases.good_example: "Itu karakter Unicode aksara Jawa (Rerenggan)... yang bentuknya kayak payung kembar" (id/usecase/nama-ff-keren/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: blank/invisible in-game name
phrases.content_surface: dedicated tool page, FAQ, gaming blogs
phrases.usage_guidance: Primary term for the invisible-name goal; pair with a risk note (cheater-suspicion/report risk in squad play) per internal research rather than presenting it as a pure cosmetic trick.
phrases.good_example: "Gimana cara bikin nama kosong di Free Fire atau Mobile Legends?" (id/spasi-kosong/index.html FAQ)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: blank space characters (broader than just names)
phrases.usage_guidance: Broader umbrella term than 'nama kosong' - covers bio blank lines and WA blank messages, not just game names.
phrases.good_example: "Copas spasi kosong & karakter kosong (zero width space, Hangul filler, braille) buat nama kosong FF/ML, bio IG kosong, & pesan WA kosong" (id/spasi-kosong/index.html meta)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: tofu / boxes / broken-glyph rendering
phrases.content_surface: FAQ across library/ and usecase/ pages
phrases.usage_guidance: Standard troubleshooting term across the ID site for the tofu-rendering problem; 'rusak' (broken) is a close synonym used for the same failure mode, and '▯' is the visual glyph the copy itself references.
phrases.good_example: "Kotak kosong berarti perangkat atau browser yang melihatnya tidak punya glyph untuk karakter itu" (id/library/simbol-facebook/index.html, id/library/simbol-discord/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: invalid character (system rejects the character itself)
phrases.usage_guidance: Distinguish from 'kotak' in copy: 'karakter tidak valid' = rejected before saving; 'kotak' = saved but renders as a box for other viewers. The repo's own PUBG page already makes this distinction explicitly.
phrases.good_example: "Kenapa PUBG kadang muncul 'karakter tidak valid' padahal simbolnya jalan normal di tempat lain?" (id/library/simbol-pubg/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: rejected (name/symbol/style rejected by the platform)
phrases.content_surface: FAQ across many pages, homepage tips
phrases.usage_guidance: Standard verb across the site for any platform-side rejection (name policy, font not supported, symbol not saved). Pair with the site's own recovery advice pattern: "ganti ke gaya lain" (switch to a safer style).
phrases.good_example: "Kalau gaya tertentu ditolak game, ganti ke gaya lain — Small Caps dan Ultra Bold biasanya paling aman" (id/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: character limit
phrases.usage_guidance: Core term for the word/character counter tool; the tool's own copy usefully distinguishes 'batas keras (hard limit)' vs 'batas lunak/praktis (soft limit)' - reuse that distinction anywhere character limits are discussed.
phrases.good_example: "Batas keras (hard limit)... diberlakukan langsung oleh platformnya... Batas lunak/praktis (soft limit)... tidak menghalangi kamu mengetik lebih banyak" (id/penghitung-kata-dan-karakter/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: to fit within / clear the character limit
phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the verb of reassurance for pre-validated ready-made names ('semua nama lolos batas 12 karakter') - ties directly to the site's Cek Nama / name-checker feature and game-rules.js weighting.
phrases.good_example: "Semua nama lolos batas 12 karakter" (id/usecase/nama-ff-keren-cowok/index.html meta); "pas 4-12 karakter biar gak ditolak" (id/usecase/nama-stumble-guys-keren/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: Free Fire's in-game rename token/item
phrases.register: gamer casual, official-adjacent (matches Garena's own in-game item name)
phrases.usage_guidance: Always name this item when instructing an FF rename - it is a spent, often-paid resource, so copy should reassure players a name will actually work (pre-validated char count) before they spend it.
phrases.good_example: "buka Free Fire → Pengaturan → ubah nickname (butuh Kartu Ganti Nama), lalu tempel" (id/usecase/nama-ff-keren/index.html); "Kartu Ganti Nama kamu nggak kebuang sia-sia" (id/spasi-kosong/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: fierce/badass (masculine aggressive style)
phrases.usage_guidance: Primary style descriptor for masculine/aggressive gaming names, always paired with skull/blade/kanji symbol imagery in copy.
phrases.good_example: "Nama FF buat cowok yang sangar, seram, dan berbau pro player" (id/usecase/nama-ff-keren-cowok/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: Feminine-targeted style pages (use 'manis' instead).

phrases.english_concept: sweet/cute (feminine style)
phrases.usage_guidance: Use for feminine-styled gaming names, often deliberately contrasted with a 'sangar' element in the same name for a cute/fierce combo.
phrases.good_example: "Manis di depan, headshot di belakang — kontras cute + sangar" (id/usecase/nama-ff-keren-cewek/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: Masculine-targeted pages.

phrases.english_concept: scary/creepy (horror-adjacent style)
phrases.usage_guidance: Covers two related but distinct uses: gaming-name horror flavor ('seram') and Zalgo/glitch text horror framing ('menyeramkan') - keep both forms since they serve slightly different pages.
phrases.good_example: "Generator Teks Zalgo — Teks Glitch, Terkutuk, dan Menyeramkan" (id/usecase/zalgo-text/index.html); "sangar, seram, dan berbau pro player" (id/usecase/nama-ff-keren-cowok/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: hero/champion identity framing for a name
phrases.usage_guidance: Use for the 'single power word' naming pattern distinct from symbol-heavy decoration - e.g. Raja, Maut, Bantai, Garuda.
phrases.good_example: "gabungin satu kata power pendek (Raja, Maut, Bantai, Garuda) sama simbol sangar" (id/usecase/nama-ff-keren-cowok/index.html); "nama sangar, pro, dan jagoan khusus cowok" (id/usecase/nama-ff-keren/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: criticizing excessive/childish over-decoration
phrases.register: casual, self-aware/ironic since 'alay' itself is a dated-but-recognized label
phrases.usage_guidance: Use as a restraint signal on pages selling a 'tasteful' decorated name (romantic contact names, minimal bios) - reassures the user the output won't look like dated over-decorated 2000s text.
phrases.good_example: "pacar cowok yang gak alay" (id/usecase/nama-kontak-pacar-aesthetic/index.html); "nama alay atau nama kece" as a named synonym cluster (id/usecase/nama-keren/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: On pages that are themselves selling maximal/heavy decoration (e.g. FF payung+mahkota+katakana pages) - contradicts the pitch there.

phrases.english_concept: criticizing gaudy/tacky over-decoration
phrases.usage_guidance: Use for a 'one styled line, rest plain' formula - the site's own copy states the rule explicitly: one line styled, the rest plain, to avoid looking norak.
phrases.good_example: "Rumusnya: satu baris bergaya, sisanya polos, biar gak norak" (id/font-wa/index.html); "Kata-kata singkat yang gak norak — tetap aesthetic" (id/usecase/bio-ig-aesthetic/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: criticizing over-the-top/dramatic decoration
phrases.usage_guidance: Distinct nuance from 'norak' (visually gaudy) - 'lebay' is about tone/drama being overdone, not just visual clutter. Both appear as parallel restraint markers on sibling bio pages.
phrases.good_example: "Santai, gak lebay, cukup satu baris" (id/usecase/bio-tiktok-aesthetic/index.html); "Kalem, gak lebay — cukup satu baris yang ngena" (id/usecase/bio-ig-aesthetic/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: regional/older synonyms for 'cool name'
phrases.usage_guidance: The site correctly notes these are regionally-used neutral synonyms, not universally negative - useful for capturing query variants without implying the whole site endorses 'alay' as an aesthetic label. Confirmed still current/live in 2026 (KBBI-recognized), not dated slang - but note it can carry a negative charge in OTHER contexts (see ID-021 'gak alay'), so tone is context-dependent.
phrases.good_example: "nama alay — atau yang di beberapa daerah lebih akrab disebut nama alay atau nama kece, istilah beda tapi maksudnya sama" (id/usecase/nama-keren/index.html); "Generator nama keren (banyak yang nyebutnya nama alay atau nama kece)" (id/usecase/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: As a primary H1/title term, since 'alay' is double-edged (neutral-synonym in some regions, insult in others) - the repo correctly keeps it as a parenthetical, not a headline term.

phrases.english_concept: not yet taken / not yet used by anyone else
phrases.content_surface: meta descriptions, ready-made name list framing
phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the positive-framing counterpart to the 'ditolak/nama sudah digunakan' problem - promise names are fresh/unclaimed, not just stylish.
phrases.good_example: "kumpulan nama FF pro, old, dan yang belum dipakai" (id/usecase/nama-ff-keren/index.html meta); "cek ketersediaan (belum dipakai)" (id/usecase/nama-panggilan/index.html, Roblox section)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: not generic/common (anti-mainstream)
phrases.usage_guidance: Confirmed live in repo as 'Kombinasi Langka (Biar Belum Dipasaran)' - a genuine native Indonesian idiom, distinct from the English-derived 'anti-mainstream'. Prefer 'pasaran/dipasaran' phrasing over borrowing 'mainstream' where a fully native option already exists in the site's own voice.
phrases.good_example: "Kombinasi Langka (Biar Belum Dipasaran)" (id/usecase/nama-guild-ff-keren/index.html H2)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: nickname/moniker (for a group, a person, a pet name)
phrases.usage_guidance: Use for both senses the repo already covers: a shared group identity ('julukan circle kamu') and a private couple's pet name ('julukan yang cuma kalian berdua yang ngerti').
phrases.good_example: "Ambil huruf depan dari nama julukan grup kamu" (id/usecase/nama-grup-keren/index.html); "julukan yang cuma kalian berdua yang ngerti maksudnya" (id/usecase/nama-kontak-pacar-aesthetic/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: boyfriend/girlfriend/romantic partner (informal address)
phrases.usage_guidance: Central term for the romantic-contact-name usecase; the page's own placeholder text and hero copy both lean on 'doi' rather than the more formal 'pasangan' or 'pacar' alone, matching how the target audience actually talks.
phrases.good_example: placeholder="Ketik panggilan sayang buat doi…" (id/usecase/nama-kontak-pacar-aesthetic/index.html); "panggilan buat doi laki-laki" in title/meta
phrases.avoid_when: Formal/legal or older-audience contexts, where 'pasangan' is more appropriate.

phrases.english_concept: slang abbreviation for the game Free Fire
phrases.content_surface: dedicated FAQ block on the FF usecase page
phrases.usage_guidance: The repo's own FAQ explicitly explains the register ladder: 'Nickname FF' (English loanword) / 'nama epep' (Indonesian gamer slang) / 'nama FF keren' (most common/neutral) all mean the same thing - keep this explainer, it correctly teaches the synonym cluster instead of just picking one.
phrases.good_example: "'Nickname FF' pakai kata serapan Inggris, 'nama epep' pakai slang gamer Indonesia (epep = cara ngomong 'FF')" (id/usecase/nama-ff-keren/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: As a page H1/title (too informal/narrow) - correctly kept as an FAQ/secondary term in the repo, not the primary heading.

phrases.native_phrase: clan tag / tag klan / tag squad
phrases.english_concept: clan/squad tag abbreviation attached to a gaming name
phrases.content_surface: library symbol pages, usecase guild/squad pages
phrases.usage_guidance: The repo overwhelmingly keeps 'clan tag' in English (18+ instances) with only one native 'tag klan' instance and some hybrid 'tag squad' - this matches how independent Indonesian gaming media (GGWP.id, Suara.com) write about squad names, which favor native 'singkatan' (abbreviation) over translating 'tag' itself. Treat 'clan tag' (English) as the dominant, natural, already-correct form; do not bulk-replace with 'tag klan'.
phrases.good_example: "mengizinkan kebanyakan karakter Unicode ini... clan tag" (id/library/simbol-fortnite/index.html); "tag squad pendek dan singkatan (3–5 huruf)" (id/usecase/nama-guild-ff-keren/index.html); "Karakter bernuansa combat buat tag klan" (id/library/simbol-pubg/index.html, the one native-translated instance)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a - current mixed usage is natural, not an error

phrases.english_concept: cool/stylish (colloquial synonym of keren)
phrases.register: casual, youth-leaning, Jakarta-origin but nationally understood
phrases.content_surface: font-snapchat page (heavy repeated use), scattered library pages
phrases.usage_guidance: Reliable supporting synonym for 'keren' - use for variety in repeated FAQ copy (e.g. font-snapchat page uses it 8+ times to avoid repeating 'keren') rather than as the primary head-term, since 'keren' has the stronger established search signal site-wide.
phrases.good_example: "Bikin tulisan Snapchat kece" (id/font-snapchat/index.html meta); "gaya tulisan kece apa yang paling populer buat Snapchat?" (id/font-snapchat/index.html FAQ)
phrases.avoid_when: As a replacement for 'keren' in primary titles/H1s across the site - it is a natural supporting variant, not proven to outperform 'keren' as a head term.

phrases.english_concept: to trace over dotted letters
phrases.register: neutral, parent/teacher-facing; also the instruction wording on the sheet itself
phrases.content_surface: h1, title, meta_description, faq, tool instructions
phrases.usage_guidance: This is the head term for any id letter-tracing or name-tracing page: 'menebalkan huruf abjad A–Z', 'menebalkan nama'. It doubles as the imperative on the generated sheet ('Tebalkan huruf di bawah ini'). An id printables page that says 'menjiplak huruf' instead will read as machine-translated to every Indonesian parent.
phrases.good_example: Menebalkan huruf abjad A–Z — lembar kerja anak TK/PAUD, siap cetak.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use 'menebalkan' in a typography/UI context on this site — there it means to bold text, and on a font-generator property the collision is live. Confine it to the children's-handwriting register, or disambiguate ('menebalkan huruf putus-putus').

phrases.english_concept: worksheet — native term vs. the borrowed English one
phrases.register: 'lembar kerja' = school/neutral; 'worksheet' = urban parent, social-commerce, aspirational
phrases.usage_guidance: Use 'lembar kerja anak TK/PAUD' as the primary (broadest reach, school-legible) and let 'worksheet' appear naturally once in the same title or the meta description — Indonesian pages routinely carry both, and doing so is native behaviour rather than keyword stuffing. Do not translate 'worksheet' out of a quoted community phrase.
phrases.good_example: Download worksheet anak & lembar kerja TK/PAUD — gratis, PDF.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use 'lembar kerja' where the deliverable is a plain colouring picture with no task (that is 'gambar mewarnai'). Do not use the abbreviation 'LKS' — it specifically names the commercial school workbook, not a free printable.

phrases.english_concept: printable / ready to print
phrases.register: 'printable' = social-commerce/urban parent; 'siap cetak' = neutral, works everywhere
phrases.content_surface: title tail, meta_description, faq, button/CTA copy
phrases.usage_guidance: Use 'siap cetak' in the page's own promise copy (it is native and unambiguous) and let 'printable' carry the category framing where the audience is the urban-parent/seller community. 'Gratis' and 'PDF' belong in the same breath — Indonesian resource titles nearly always state both.
phrases.good_example: Worksheet belajar menulis — gratis, PDF, siap cetak di rumah.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use 'dapat dicetak' as a title modifier — grammatical but stiff. Do not use 'printable' alone as the only descriptor on a page aimed at TK teachers rather than the seller community.

phrases.english_concept: cursive / joined-up script (the style most requested for name tattoos)
phrases.register: neutral, everyday; 'tegak bersambung' slightly more formal/schoolbook, 'tulisan sambung' fully casual
phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the Indonesian name for the cursive/script style on the tattoo page and anywhere else the site offers cursive to Indonesian users. Prefer 'tulisan sambung' in casual body copy and 'tegak bersambung' when naming the style formally (e.g. a style-list label).
phrases.good_example: Font tegak bersambung memiliki sisi keindahan dan keunikan tersendiri — sering dipakai untuk pembuatan tato.
phrases.avoid_when: Never use 'huruf miring' as a synonym — that is italic and means something else. Do not use 'kursif' in consumer copy; it is a loanword that reads like a translated spec sheet.

phrases.native_phrase: tulisan melengkung / tulisan melingkar / tulisan bergelombang
phrases.english_concept: curved text, circular text, and wavy text
phrases.content_surface: h1, title, meta, faq, tool copy
phrases.usage_guidance: H1 on 'tulisan melengkung'. Give 'melingkar' its own FAQ/section for the full-circle logo/stiker job and 'bergelombang' its own for the wave shape — Indonesian users treat these as three distinct requests, so one page can serve all three with three clearly named sections without cannibalising itself.
phrases.good_example: Cara membuat tulisan melengkung, melingkar, dan bergelombang — untuk logo, stiker, dan hang tag.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not substitute 'teks' for 'tulisan' in the H1/title — it is grammatically correct but is the machine-translation register. Do not use 'melengkung' when you mean the full ring; that is 'melingkar'.

phrases.english_concept: the # sign / hashtag — the native Indonesian name and the acronym that became the standard word
phrases.register: neutral; 'tagar' is standard enough for news copy and dictionary use
phrases.usage_guidance: Keep the two jobs separate on the page: 'tanda pagar' names the *character* (the symbol-reference job), 'tagar' names the *social-media label* (the platform job). An Indonesian # symbol page's H1 should use 'tanda pagar (#)' and mention 'tagar' when the topic turns to social media — using 'tagar' for the bare glyph blurs a distinction Indonesian readers do make.
phrases.good_example: Tanda pagar (#) — juga dikenal sebagai tanda nomor — dipakai untuk membuat tagar di media sosial.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use 'tagar' as the name of the character in non-social contexts (a number sign in a table, a code comment, a phone keypad key) — there it is 'tanda pagar' or 'tanda nomor'. Do not use 'tanda pon' outside a units-of-weight context.

phrases.native_phrase: emotikon gaya Barat / emotikon gaya Timur
phrases.english_concept: the sideways-Western vs upright-Japanese emoticon distinction
phrases.content_surface: faq, body copy, section headings — NOT the H1
phrases.usage_guidance: Use this to explain the category in an Indonesian kaomoji page's opening paragraph or FAQ ('Apa bedanya emotikon gaya Barat dan gaya Timur?'). The H1 should still carry the transactional phrase people type ('emoticon lucu untuk di-copas'), because 'gaya Timur' is a description, not a search term.
phrases.good_example: Emotikon gaya Timur bisa dibaca tanpa memiringkan kepala, beda dengan emotikon gaya Barat seperti :) yang harus dilihat menyamping.
phrases.avoid_when: Never as the page's H1 or primary target — it has no search demand of its own. Avoid in gaming-nickname copy where the register is slangier.

phrases.english_concept: ASCII art — picture built from characters
phrases.content_surface: faq, first-paragraph gloss — NOT the H1
phrases.usage_guidance: Keep 'ASCII art' in the Indonesian page's title and H1; use 'seni ASCII' once as the Indonesian gloss so the definitional query is also served. Do not translate the term throughout — it makes the page read like a machine translation of the EN parent.
phrases.good_example: ASCII art (seni ASCII) adalah gambar yang dibuat dari rangkaian karakter keyboard.
phrases.avoid_when: Never as the sole term in the title. Avoid in casual/social copy where nobody would say it.

phrases.english_concept: copypasta — canned spam text block in chat (and the trap of confusing it with 'copas')
phrases.usage_guidance: Use only in a boundary FAQ on ASCII-art or big-text pages: pasting the same block repeatedly is 'copypasta' and gets you muted. Keep 'copas' for the ordinary action.
phrases.good_example: Kalau kamu spam gambar yang sama berkali-kali, itu dianggap copypasta dan biasanya kena mute di server Discord.
phrases.avoid_when: Never in a title, H1, meta, or CTA. Never in copy for parents/teachers/education, and never on the printable/practice-sheet surfaces.

phrases.english_concept: the Indonesian default meaning of 'calligraphy' is Arabic/Islamic — Latin-script calligraphy must be named explicitly
phrases.register: neutral; 'kaligrafi' unqualified carries a religious register
phrases.content_surface: faq, body copy; qualifier is mandatory wherever the word appears
phrases.usage_guidance: Never use bare 'kaligrafi' on an Indonesian page about Latin-script styling — either qualify it as 'kaligrafi latin' or avoid the word and use 'font script' / 'tulisan sambung'. If the page targets 'font kaligrafi undangan', add a one-line disambiguation so an Indonesian reader arriving from an Islamic-calligraphy query is not misled.
phrases.good_example: Yang dimaksud di sini adalah kaligrafi latin — gaya tulisan sambung yang elegan untuk nama, bukan kaligrafi Arab (khat).
phrases.avoid_when: SENSITIVITY: never apply 'kaligrafi' framing, Arabic-script ornament, or khat styles to gaming/nickname pages, novelty pages, or any playful surface. In Indonesia kaligrafi is bound to Qur'anic verses, hadith and the lafadz Allah/Muhammad; using it decoratively next to 'nama epep' or 'font keren' would be read as disrespectful by a religious majority audience. This is also why the site's existing ID-007 (simbol payung ꧁꧂) and this record must never appear on the same page.

phrases.native_phrase: harus memasang font unicode / install font unicode dulu
phrases.english_concept: the "you must install a Unicode font" belief — and why it is only half a misconception in Indonesia
phrases.content_surface: faq heading, body — not h1, not tool copy
phrases.usage_guidance: Answer the belief on its own terms rather than flatly denying it: state that copas works without installing anything, then explain that installing a Unicode font changes only what that one device can render, not what the recipient sees. Denying it outright contradicts what the user has read elsewhere and costs trust.
phrases.good_example: Nggak perlu install font apa pun buat bikin tulisannya — install font unicode cuma ngaruh ke tampilan di HP kamu sendiri, bukan di HP orang yang baca.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use the flat 'tidak perlu install font' claim without the second half of the explanation — in the ID market that reads as contradicting known-good advice. Not a title/H1 term.

phrases.native_phrase: cara enter di bio / ganti baris
phrases.english_concept: the line-break action that produces stacked text in a bio or caption
phrases.content_surface: h2, faq heading, tool copy, body
phrases.usage_guidance: Use «cara enter di bio Instagram» as the how-to heading (it is the literal query) and «ganti baris» in the explanatory sentence. Frame the payoff as «biar rapi» — Indonesian how-to copy consistently justifies formatting by tidiness/readability, not by aesthetics, and that framing is what makes the copy read as locally written.
phrases.good_example: Cara enter di bio Instagram biar tulisannya turun ke bawah dan bionya kelihatan rapi.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use it for a one-letter-per-line decorative effect — it names the line-break action only. Avoid «enter» as a verb in formal, legal or accessibility copy, where «ganti baris» or «baris baru» is the right register.

phrases.english_concept: the platform merging the stacked lines back together after saving
phrases.usage_guidance: Use «tulisannya menempel» in the FAQ heading describing the symptom and «tidak bisa enter» when the answer addresses the app not offering the key at all — they are two different user situations and Indonesian sources address both. Follow with the invisible-space fix (ID-009) or the draft-and-paste route.
phrases.good_example: Kenapa tulisan di caption menempel padahal sudah dikasih spasi sebelum diposting?
phrases.avoid_when: Not a title/H1 term. Do not use it for glyph failures (ID-010 kotak-kotak) — that is an unsupported character, this is stripped formatting, and the fixes are unrelated.

phrases.native_phrase: penghitung karakter / penghitung kata / hitung jumlah karakter
phrases.english_concept: character counter / word counter (the tool category head terms)
phrases.usage_guidance: Head terms for the tool category. Native supply is thinner than VN's: Google served machine-translated proxies of English tools (translate.google.com wrappers of charactercounter.com/sproutsocial) in the ID SERP for related queries — a supply-gap signal. 'menghitung jumlah kata di Word' is the dominant how-to phrasing (IDN Times, kumparan, liputan6 all title on it).
